item.title: Correction · Park Terrace: The map notes gave 110 units and a 2007 build with only an OSM way…
item.description: The map notes gave 110 units and a 2007 build with only an OSM way cited, and said the developer was not confirmed. A dated note now cites SocketSite (May 2006: 110 units, seven stories, developers Opus West and Phoenix Property Company) and the DataSF Assessor roll (year built 2007). The 2006 and 2007 milestones cite those pages instead of a bare domain and an uncheckable listing, and the comparison with other condo-mapped towers no longer lists Avalon II and III. Source: SocketSite, 2006-05-05 (https://socketsite.com/archives/2006/05/new_development_8.html); DataSF Assessor Historical Secured Property Tax Rolls, 325 Berry St condominium lots (https://data.sf.gov/resource/wv5m-vpq2.json?parcel_number=8707009); DataSF Parcels (https://data.sfgov.org/Geographic-Locations-and-Boundaries/Parcels-Active-and-Retired/acdm-wktn).
